headline: Germany's political center fights for relevance after far-right and far-left gains
context: Centrist politicians are soul-searching after electoral gains by the far right and the far left. Today's weak coalitions, political fragmentation and dire economy echo a past that led to the rise of fascism.

sources.name: NPR
